CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_identity_build_material_v2(t astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE rows jsonb;digest text;
BEGIN
 WITH requested AS (
  SELECT m.member_id,m.anchor_ticker symbol,m.anchor,(d->>'date')::date AS requested_date
  FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_members_v2 m CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(t.scope->'calendar','[]')) d
  WHERE m.run_id=t.run_id AND (t.kind='derive_breadth' OR (t.scope->'member_ids') ? m.member_id)
 )
 SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('member_id',q.member_id,'symbol',q.symbol,'market_date',q.requested_date,
  'state',COALESCE(c.state,'IDENTITY_OR_QUALITY_UNRESOLVED'),'reason',COALESCE(c.reason,CASE WHEN c.state IS NULL THEN 'DATED_IDENTITY_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE' END),
  'identity_anchor',c.identity_anchor,'cik',c.cik,'composite_figi',c.composite_figi,'share_class_figi',c.share_class_figi,
  'historical_symbol',c.historical_symbol,'security_type',c.security_type,'primary_exchange',c.primary_exchange,'eligible',c.eligible,
  'anchor_identity',jsonb_build_object('member_id',q.member_id,'symbol',q.symbol,'reference_date',q.anchor->>'anchor_observation_date',
   'cik',substring(q.member_id from 5),'composite_figi',q.anchor->>'anchor_composite_figi','share_class_figi',q.anchor->>'anchor_share_class_figi',
   'security_type',q.anchor->>'anchor_security_type','primary_exchange',q.anchor->>'anchor_exchange',
   'membership_accepted',q.anchor->'membership_accepted','cohort_sha256',q.anchor->>'cohort_sha256',
   'anchor_sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(astra_ingestion_v1.rpc_canonical(q.anchor),'UTF8')),'hex')),
  'evidence_sha256',c.evidence_sha256,'retrospective_only',true,'strict_historical_availability_certified',false,
  'input_body_sha256',CASE WHEN t.kind='derive_breadth' THEN b.body_sha256 END) ORDER BY q.member_id,q.requested_date),'[]') INTO rows
 FROM requested q LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT ic.* FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_identity_current_v2 ic
  WHERE ic.run_id=t.run_id AND ic.member_id=q.member_id AND ic.market_date=q.requested_date OFFSET 0) c ON true
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT bi.body_sha256 FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_breadth_inputs_v2 bi
   JOIN astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_readbacks_v2 rb ON rb.task_id=bi.task_id AND rb.page_no=bi.page_no
   WHERE t.kind='derive_breadth' AND bi.run_id=t.run_id AND bi.member_id=q.member_id AND bi.market_date=q.requested_date
   ORDER BY bi.source_committed_at DESC,bi.task_id,bi.page_no DESC LIMIT 1) b ON true;
 IF jsonb_array_length(rows)>3000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='AI005',MESSAGE='Identity material exceeds fixed bounded unit'; END IF;
 digest:=encode(sha256(convert_to(astra_ingestion_v1.rpc_canonical(rows),'UTF8')),'hex');
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('version','fixed3000-retrospective-identity-v2.2','run_id',t.run_id,'task_id',t.id,
  'mappings',rows,'identity_material_sha256',digest,'evidence_revision',digest);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_identity_source_meta_v2(p_source uuid, p_day date, p_body boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET statement_timeout TO '8s'
AS $function$
DECLARE s market_governance.remediation_source_response_v1;b market_governance.remediation_source_batch_v1;
BEGIN
 IF p_day NOT BETWEEN '2025-06-05'::date AND '2026-07-31'::date THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('state','SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE','reason','REFERENCE_DATE_OUTSIDE_TARGET_AND_SUPPORT'); END IF;
 SELECT * INTO s FROM market_governance.remediation_source_response_v1 WHERE source_id=p_source;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('state','SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE','reason','ORIGINAL_SOURCE_RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND'); END IF;
 SELECT * INTO b FROM market_governance.remediation_source_batch_v1 WHERE batch_id=s.batch_id;
 IF NOT FOUND OR b.provider<>'massive' OR b.source_type<>'massive_reference_tickers' OR b.status<>'COMPLETE'
 OR b.request_json->>'reference_date' IS DISTINCT FROM p_day::text
 OR (b.start_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date IS DISTINCT FROM p_day
 OR s.http_status<>200 OR s.storage_encoding<>'gzip' OR s.credential_redactions<>0
 OR s.original_bytes NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4194304 OR octet_length(s.compressed_body)>2097152
 OR s.source_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM s.stored_body_sha256
 OR sha256(s.compressed_body) IS DISTINCT FROM s.compressed_sha256
 OR (s.source_url NOT LIKE 'https://api.massive.com/v3/reference/tickers?%' AND s.source_url NOT LIKE 'https://api.polygon.io/v3/reference/tickers?%')
 THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('state','SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE','reason','ORIGINAL_SOURCE_PROFILE_OR_COMPRESSED_HASH_DIFFERS'); END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('state','RETAINED_SOURCE_READY','source_id',s.source_id,'batch_id',s.batch_id,'market_date',p_day,
  'source_sha256',encode(s.source_sha256,'hex'),'compressed_sha256',encode(s.compressed_sha256,'hex'),
  'original_bytes',s.original_bytes,'storage_encoding',s.storage_encoding,'received_at',s.received_at,
  'source_endpoint','/v3/reference/tickers','retrospective_only',true,
  'compressed_body_base64',CASE WHEN p_body THEN replace(encode(s.compressed_body,'base64'),E'\n','') END);
END $function$

 v_end timestamptz;
 v_after timestamptz;
 v_mode text:=COALESCE(p_payload->>'mode','summary');
 v_limit int:=GREATEST(1,LEAST(COALESCE((p_payload->>'limit')::int,2000),2000));
 v_result jsonb;
 v_count int;
BEGIN
 -- Existing worker RPC authenticates before dispatch. Readback additionally
 -- binds the live claim, generation, fence, immutable scope and frozen member.
 -- This helper cannot write; a later commit must recheck the current fence.
 IF pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(c) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR v_mode NOT IN ('summary','material') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='AI005',MESSAGE='Invalid retained-read request';
 END IF;
 SELECT * INTO t FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 WHERE id=c->>'id';
 IF NOT FOUND OR t.run_id IS DISTINCT FROM c->>'run_id' OR t.status<>'RUNNING'
 OR t.owner IS DISTINCT FROM c->>'owner' OR t.generation::text IS DISTINCT FROM c->>'generation'
 OR t.run_fence::text IS DISTINCT FROM c->>'run_fence' OR t.page_no::text IS DISTINCT FROM c->>'page_no'
 OR t.lease_until IS NULL OR t.attempt_deadline IS NULL
 OR t.lease_until<=pg_catalog.clock_timestamp() OR t.attempt_deadline<=pg_catalog.clock_timestamp() THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='AI001',MESSAGE='Retained-read claim, family or lease is not current';
 END IF;
 active_task:=t;
 IF t.kind IN ('derive_daily','derive_intraday') AND lower(t.provider)='derived'
 AND t.family IN ('D01','D02','D03','D04','D05') AND v_mode='material' THEN
   IF p_payload->>'source_task_id' IS NULL OR NOT (p_payload->>'source_task_id'=ANY(t.dependencies)) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='AI005',MESSAGE='Retained material must be a direct immutable dependency'; END IF;
   SELECT * INTO source_task FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 WHERE id=p_payload->>'source_task_id';
   IF NOT FOUND OR source_task.run_id<>t.run_id OR source_task.kind<>'retained_reuse'
   OR lower(source_task.provider)<>'reuse'
   OR source_task.status NOT IN ('INGESTED','IDENTITY_OR_QUALITY_UNRESOLVED')
   OR source_task.scope->'member_ids' IS DISTINCT FROM t.scope->'member_ids' THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='AI005',MESSAGE='Retained dependency is not committed for the same frozen member'; END IF;
   t:=source_task;
 ELSIF t.kind<>'retained_reuse' OR lower(t.provider)<>'reuse'
 OR t.family NOT IN ('P01','P02','D01','D02') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='AI005',MESSAGE='Task kind cannot access retained source material';
 END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT r FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_runs_v2 WHERE id=t.run_id;
 IF r.status<>'ACTIVE' OR r.fence<>active_task.run_fence
 OR r.cohort_sha256<>'2dc0f766befed6de6b052221c3c87482d507ba1bad931cbb98654eb3af899bec'
 OR r.target_start<>'2025-09-01'::date OR r.target_end<>'2026-07-31'::date
 OR jsonb_typeof(t.scope->'member_ids') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR jsonb_array_length(t.scope->'member_ids')<>1 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='AI005',MESSAGE='Retained-read frozen replacement scope differs';
 END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT m FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_members_v2
  WHERE run_id=t.run_id AND member_id=t.scope#>>'{member_ids,0}';
 SELECT * INTO STRICT i FROM reference.alpaca_fixed_window_instruments_v1
  WHERE instrument_key=(t.scope->>'instrument_key')::int;
 IF i.alpaca_asset_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM t.scope->>'alpaca_asset_id'
 OR i.symbol IS DISTINCT FROM t.scope->>'symbol' OR i.symbol IS DISTINCT FROM m.anchor_ticker THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='AI005',MESSAGE='Retained provider security and frozen anchor differ';
 END IF;
 -- Anchor equality permits raw-source reuse only. It does not prove a dated
 -- historical company/security mapping; this limitation is always returned.
 v_start:=(t.scope->>'start')::timestamptz;
 v_end:=(t.scope->>'end_exclusive')::timestamptz;
 IF v_start IS NULL OR v_end IS NULL OR NOT pg_catalog.isfinite(v_start) OR NOT pg_catalog.isfinite(v_end)
 OR v_start>=v_end OR v_end-v_start>interval '32 days'
 OR v_start<('2025-08-04 00:00:00'::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')
 OR v_end>('2026-08-01 00:00:00'::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')
 OR date_trunc('month',v_start AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')<>
    date_trunc('month',(v_end-interval '1 microsecond') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='AI005',MESSAGE='Retained-read range must fit one admitted calendar month';
 END IF;
 IF p_payload->>'after' IS NOT NULL THEN
   v_after:=(p_payload->>'after')::timestamptz;
   IF NOT pg_catalog.isfinite(v_after) OR v_after<v_start OR v_after>=v_end THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='AI005',MESSAGE='Retained-read cursor is outside the immutable range'; END IF;
 END IF;
 -- A derivation can read only the intersection of its own input window and
 -- its committed retained dependency. The caller cannot widen either scope.
 IF active_task.kind IN ('derive_daily','derive_intraday') THEN
   IF active_task.scope->>'input_start' IS NOT NULL THEN
     v_start:=GREATEST(v_start,(active_task.scope->>'input_start')::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York');
   END IF;
   IF active_task.scope->>'target_end' IS NOT NULL THEN
     v_end:=LEAST(v_end,((active_task.scope->>'target_end')::date+1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York');
   END IF;
   IF v_after IS NOT NULL AND (v_after<v_start OR v_after>=v_end) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='AI005',MESSAGE='Retained material cursor is outside derived input scope'; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF v_mode='summary' AND v_after IS NOT NULL THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='AI005',MESSAGE='A retained summary must cover its whole immutable range';
 END IF;

 WITH bounded AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT b.instrument_key,b.bar_ts,b.session_label::text AS session_label,
    b.open,b.high,b.low,b.close,b.volume,b.trade_count,b.vwap,b.loaded_by_job_id,b.source_loaded_at
  FROM market_fixed_20250901_20260831.alpaca_sip_bars_1m b
  WHERE b.instrument_key=i.instrument_key AND b.bar_ts>=v_start AND b.bar_ts<v_end
    AND (v_after IS NULL OR b.bar_ts>v_after)
  ORDER BY b.bar_ts LIMIT CASE WHEN v_mode='summary' THEN 40001 ELSE v_limit+1 END
 ), measured AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT b.*,j.id AS provenance_job_id,
   COALESCE(j.config->>'feed'='sip' AND j.config->>'adjustment'='raw'
    AND j.config->'timeframes' @> '["1Min"]'::jsonb
    AND (j.config->>'start_date')::date<=(b.bar_ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date
    AND (j.config->>'end_date')::date>=(b.bar_ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date,false) AS qualifying_profile,
   COALESCE(b.open>0 AND b.high>0 AND b.low>0 AND b.close>0 AND b.volume>=0
    AND b.high>=GREATEST(b.open,b.close,b.low) AND b.low<=LEAST(b.open,b.close,b.high)
    AND b.open NOT IN ('Infinity'::float8,'-Infinity'::float8,'NaN'::float8)
    AND b.high NOT IN ('Infinity'::float8,'-Infinity'::float8,'NaN'::float8)
    AND b.low NOT IN ('Infinity'::float8,'-Infinity'::float8,'NaN'::float8)
    AND b.close NOT IN ('Infinity'::float8,'-Infinity'::float8,'NaN'::float8),false) AS valid_ohlcv,
   encode(sha256(convert_to(to_jsonb(b)::text,'UTF8')),'hex') AS row_sha256
  FROM bounded b LEFT JOIN market_provenance.alpaca_populator_jobs_v1 j ON j.id=b.loaded_by_job_id
 ), selected AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT * FROM measured ORDER BY bar_ts LIMIT CASE WHEN v_mode='summary' THEN 40001 ELSE v_limit END
 )
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
   'record_count',count(*),'qualifying_profile_count',count(*) FILTER(WHERE qualifying_profile),
   'valid_ohlcv_count',count(*) FILTER(WHERE valid_ohlcv),
   'usable_source_count',count(*) FILTER(WHERE qualifying_profile AND valid_ohlcv),
   'first_bar',min(bar_ts),'last_bar',max(bar_ts),
   'source_digest',encode(sha256(convert_to(COALESCE(string_agg(row_sha256,'' ORDER BY bar_ts),''),'UTF8')),'hex'),
   'digest_algorithm','sha256-concatenated-ordered-postgres-jsonb-row-sha256-v1',
   'rth_count',count(*) FILTER(WHERE session_label='regular'),
   'pre_count',count(*) FILTER(WHERE session_label='premarket'),
   'post_count',count(*) FILTER(WHERE session_label='postmarket'),
   'qualified_rth_count',count(*) FILTER(WHERE qualifying_profile AND session_label='regular'),
   'qualified_pre_count',count(*) FILTER(WHERE qualifying_profile AND session_label='premarket'),
   'qualified_post_count',count(*) FILTER(WHERE qualifying_profile AND session_label='postmarket'),
   'usable_rth_count',count(*) FILTER(WHERE qualifying_profile AND valid_ohlcv AND session_label='regular'),
   'usable_pre_count',count(*) FILTER(WHERE qualifying_profile AND valid_ohlcv AND session_label='premarket'),
   'usable_post_count',count(*) FILTER(WHERE qualifying_profile AND valid_ohlcv AND session_label='postmarket'),
   'overnight_count',count(*) FILTER(WHERE session_label='overnight'),
   'unknown_session_count',count(*) FILTER(WHERE session_label NOT IN ('regular','premarket','postmarket','overnight') OR session_label IS NULL),
   'source_job_ids',COALESCE(jsonb_agg(DISTINCT loaded_by_job_id) FILTER(WHERE loaded_by_job_id IS NOT NULL),'[]'),
   'source_loaded_at_min',min(source_loaded_at),'source_loaded_at_max',max(source_loaded_at),
   'session_coverage',CASE WHEN v_mode='summary' THEN (
     SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(z ORDER BY z.market_date),'[]') FROM (
       SELECT (bar_ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS market_date,
        count(*) AS record_count,count(*) FILTER(WHERE qualifying_profile) AS qualifying_profile_count,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE qualifying_profile AND valid_ohlcv) AS usable_source_count,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE session_label='regular') AS rth_count,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE session_label='premarket') AS pre_count,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE session_label='postmarket') AS post_count,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE qualifying_profile AND session_label='regular') AS qualified_rth_count,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE qualifying_profile AND session_label='premarket') AS qualified_pre_count,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE qualifying_profile AND session_label='postmarket') AS qualified_post_count,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE qualifying_profile AND valid_ohlcv AND session_label='regular') AS usable_rth_count,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE qualifying_profile AND valid_ohlcv AND session_label='premarket') AS usable_pre_count,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE qualifying_profile AND valid_ohlcv AND session_label='postmarket') AS usable_post_count,
        min(bar_ts) AS first_bar,max(bar_ts) AS last_bar
       FROM selected GROUP BY 1) z) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END,
   'days_without_retained_rows',CASE WHEN v_mode='summary' THEN (
     SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(e->>'date' ORDER BY e->>'date'),'[]')
     FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(t.scope->'calendar','[]'::jsonb)) e
     WHERE (e->>'date')::date>=(v_start AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date
       AND (e->>'date')::date<=((v_end-interval '1 microsecond') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date
       AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM selected s WHERE (s.bar_ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date=(e->>'date')::date)
   ) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END,
   'days_with_unqualified_profile',CASE WHEN v_mode='summary' THEN (
     SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(z.market_date ORDER BY z.market_date),'[]') FROM (
       SELECT DISTINCT (bar_ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS market_date FROM selected WHERE NOT qualifying_profile) z
   ) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END,
   'days_with_invalid_ohlcv',CASE WHEN v_mode='summary' THEN (
     SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(z.market_date ORDER BY z.market_date),'[]') FROM (
       SELECT DISTINCT (bar_ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS market_date FROM selected WHERE NOT valid_ohlcv) z
   ) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END,
   'has_more',CASE WHEN v_mode='material' THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM bounded)>v_limit ELSE false END,
   'next_after',CASE WHEN v_mode='material' AND (SELECT count(*) FROM bounded)>v_limit THEN max(bar_ts) END,
   'rows',CASE WHEN v_mode='material' THEN COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
     'symbol',i.symbol,'timestamp',bar_ts,'market_date',(bar_ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date,
     'session',CASE session_label WHEN 'regular' THEN 'RTH' WHEN 'premarket' THEN 'PRE' WHEN 'postmarket' THEN 'POST' ELSE 'OUTSIDE_SUPPORTED_SESSION' END,
     'timeframe','1Min','feed','sip','adjustment','raw','saved_session_label',session_label,
     'source',jsonb_build_object('t',bar_ts,'o',open,'h',high,'l',low,'c',close,'v',volume,'n',trade_count,'vw',vwap),
     'instrument_key',instrument_key,'alpaca_asset_id',i.alpaca_asset_id,'loaded_by_job_id',loaded_by_job_id,
     'source_loaded_at',source_loaded_at,'source_row_sha256',row_sha256,
     'provenance_qualified',qualifying_profile,'valid_ohlcv',valid_ohlcv,
     'support_history',(bar_ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date<'2025-09-01'::date,
     'mapping_state','IDENTITY_OR_QUALITY_UNRESOLVED') ORDER BY bar_ts),'[]') ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
 ) INTO v_result FROM selected;
 v_count:=(v_result->>'record_count')::int;
 IF v_mode='summary' AND v_count>40000 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='AI005',MESSAGE='Retained summary exceeded40000 rows; split its date unit';
 END IF;
 RETURN v_result||jsonb_build_object(
   'state',CASE WHEN v_count=0 THEN 'NO_RETAINED_ROWS' ELSE 'RETAINED_SOURCE_READ' END,
   'mode',v_mode,'task_id',active_task.id,'source_task_id',t.id,'run_id',t.run_id,'member_id',m.member_id,
   'source_relation','market_fixed_20250901_20260831.alpaca_sip_bars_1m',
   'source_project','oxzabweahkoimtevbbny','original_source_project','mnmkxjirpwbptdnvjmpw',
   'instrument_key',i.instrument_key,'alpaca_asset_id',i.alpaca_asset_id,'symbol',i.symbol,
   'start',v_start,'end_exclusive',v_end,'observed_at',clock_timestamp(),
   'provider','Alpaca','feed','sip','adjustment','raw','timeframe','1Min',
   'mapping_state','IDENTITY_OR_QUALITY_UNRESOLVED',
   'mapping_reason','POST_WINDOW_ANCHOR_SYMBOL_MATCH_IS_NOT_HISTORICAL_IDENTITY_PROOF',
   'calendar_available',COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(t.scope->'calendar')='array',false),
   'coverage_state','UNKNOWN_PROVIDER_OBSERVATION_DENOMINATOR',
   'source_reference_provenance',i.provenance);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_run_guard_v2()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id OR NEW.instruction_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.instruction_sha256
 OR NEW.cohort_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.cohort_sha256 OR NEW.cohort_manifest_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.cohort_manifest_sha256
 OR NEW.cohort_ref IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.cohort_ref OR NEW.scope IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.scope
 OR NEW.target_start IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.target_start OR NEW.target_end IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.target_end
 OR NEW.fence<OLD.fence OR NEW.requests_reserved<OLD.requests_reserved OR NEW.pages_committed<OLD.pages_committed
 OR NEW.records_committed<OLD.records_committed OR NEW.source_bytes<OLD.source_bytes
 OR (OLD.status IN ('SUPERSEDED','COMPLETE','COMPLETE_WITH_DOCUMENTED_GAPS') AND NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Replacement run scope, cumulative accounting and terminal stop are immutable'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_s02_project_v2(p_task text, p_page integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET statement_timeout TO '8s'
AS $function$
DECLARE t astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2;p astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_pages_v2;proof jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT t FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 WHERE id=p_task;
 IF t.family<>'S02' OR t.kind NOT IN('retained_massive_archive','massive_short_interest') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_s02_projection_v2 WHERE task_id=p_task AND page_no=p_page) THEN RETURN; END IF;
 SELECT pg.* INTO STRICT p FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_pages_v2 pg JOIN astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_readbacks_v2 b USING(task_id,page_no) WHERE pg.task_id=p_task AND pg.page_no=p_page;
 IF t.kind='retained_massive_archive' THEN
  SELECT retained_s02_verification INTO proof FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_readbacks_v2 WHERE task_id=p_task AND page_no=p_page;
  IF proof->'passed' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='AI002',MESSAGE='S02 reference projection requires independent source readback'; END IF;
 END IF;
 WITH anchors AS(SELECT anchor_ticker,min(member_id) member_id FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_members_v2 WHERE run_id=t.run_id GROUP BY anchor_ticker HAVING count(*)=1),
 rows AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT q.source_row ordinal,q.raw_record row,q.raw_record_sha256 row_sha,q.source_record_key business_key,q.source_id,
   (proof->>'source_observed_at')::timestamptz observed,q.archive_key,q.page_number archive_page,q.source_row archive_row
  FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.massive_shortinterest_record_v1 q
  WHERE t.kind='retained_massive_archive' AND q.archive_key=t.scope->>'archive_key' AND q.page_number=(t.scope->>'archive_page')::int
  UNION ALL
  SELECT x.record_ordinal::int,x.source_row,encode(sha256(convert_to(x.source_row::text,'UTF8')),'hex'),
   'MassiveSI:business:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_array(x.source_row->>'ticker',x.market_date)::text,'UTF8')),'hex'),NULL,p.fetched_at,NULL,NULL,NULL
  FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_page_rows_v2(t.id,p_page) x WHERE t.kind='massive_short_interest'
 ), selected AS(
  SELECT q.*,m.member_id,m.anchor_ticker,astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_date_v2(q.row->>'settlement_date') settled FROM rows q JOIN anchors m ON m.anchor_ticker=q.row->>'ticker'
  WHERE (t.scope->'member_ids')?m.member_id AND astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_date_v2(q.row->>'settlement_date') BETWEEN '2025-09-01'::date AND '2026-07-31'::date
   AND (t.kind<>'retained_massive_archive' OR astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_date_v2(q.row->>'settlement_date')>='2026-07-15'::date)
 )
 INSERT INTO astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_s02_occurrences_v2(run_id,task_id,page_no,record_ordinal,source_origin,member_id,symbol,settlement_date,business_key,row_sha256,archive_key,archive_page,archive_row,source_id,source_observed_at,field_states)
 SELECT t.run_id,t.id,p_page,q.ordinal,CASE WHEN t.kind='retained_massive_archive' THEN 'RETAINED' ELSE 'FRESH' END,q.member_id,q.anchor_ticker,q.settled,q.business_key,q.row_sha,q.archive_key,q.archive_page,q.archive_row,q.source_id,q.observed,
  (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(f.key,jsonb_build_object('nonnull',v.value IS NOT NULL AND v.value<>'null'::jsonb,'reason',
    astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_nonminute_field_reason_v2(v.value,f.value,CASE WHEN f.key='publication_time' AND (v.value IS NULL OR v.value='null'::jsonb) THEN 'PUBLICATION_TIMESTAMP_NOT_SUPPLIED' END)))
   FROM jsonb_each_text(astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_nonminute_field_spec_v2('S02','massive_short_interest')) f
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL(SELECT astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_nonminute_field_value_v2(q.row,'SOURCE',f.key) value) v)
 FROM selected q ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 INSERT INTO astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_s02_projection_v2 VALUES(t.id,p_page) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_s02_source_check_v2(p_task text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET statement_timeout TO '8s'
AS $function$
DECLARE t astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2;r astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_runs_v2;
 p population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.massive_shortinterest_page_v1;
 d population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.source_document;b jsonb;v_candidates jsonb;v_members jsonb;v_digest text;v_bad bigint;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT t FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 WHERE id=p_task;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT r FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_runs_v2 WHERE id=t.run_id;
 IF t.kind<>'retained_massive_archive' OR t.family<>'S02' OR lower(t.provider)<>'reuse'
  OR r.cohort_sha256<>'2dc0f766befed6de6b052221c3c87482d507ba1bad931cbb98654eb3af899bec'
  OR r.target_start<>'2025-09-01'::date OR r.target_end<>'2026-07-31'::date
  OR t.scope->>'archive_key' IS DISTINCT FROM 'massive-archive:S02:c1ed3ed6aa5bad110f122c2459ba27f6daa14a7ac484363d4915c0fc9ddb1f88'
  OR COALESCE(t.scope->>'archive_page','') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]?$' OR (t.scope->>'archive_page')::int NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 45
  OR t.scope->>'settlement_start' IS DISTINCT FROM '2026-07-15' OR t.scope->>'settlement_end' IS DISTINCT FROM '2026-07-31'
  OR t.scope->'preserve_provider_acquisition' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='AI005',MESSAGE='S02 retained source differs from its fixed admitted overlay scope'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT p FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.massive_shortinterest_page_v1
  WHERE archive_key=t.scope->>'archive_key' AND page_number=(t.scope->>'archive_page')::int;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT d FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.source_document WHERE source_id=p.source_id;
 IF p.family_id<>'S02' OR p.source_id IS DISTINCT FROM t.scope->>'source_id' OR p.source_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM t.scope->>'expected_source_sha256'
  OR p.normalized_at IS NULL OR p.result_count NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000 OR p.normalized_source_records IS DISTINCT FROM p.result_count
  OR COALESCE(p.wire_sha256,'')!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' OR COALESCE(p.wire_bytes,0) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 8388608
  OR d.source_provider IS DISTINCT FROM 'Massive' OR d.source_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM p.source_sha256
  OR d.content_text IS NULL OR d.content_bytes NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 8388608
  OR octet_length(d.content_text)::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM d.content_bytes
  OR encode(sha256(convert_to(d.content_text,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM p.source_sha256
  OR d.source_uri IS DISTINCT FROM p.request_url OR d.retrieved_at IS DISTINCT FROM p.retrieved_at
  OR d.source_published_at IS NOT NULL OR d.historical_received_at IS NOT NULL
  OR d.license_policy IS DISTINCT FROM 'EXISTING_MASSIVE_SUBSCRIPTION_API_RESPONSE_INTERNAL_USE'
  OR d.evidence->>'hash_representation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'EXACT_UTF8_RESPONSE_WITH_TOP_LEVEL_NEXT_URL_CREDENTIAL_REDACTION_ONLY'
  OR d.evidence->'wire_bytes_retained' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
  OR d.evidence->'original_historical_receipt' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
  OR d.evidence->>'wire_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM p.wire_sha256
  OR d.evidence->>'wire_bytes' IS DISTINCT FROM p.wire_bytes::text
  OR d.evidence->>'stored_content_bytes' IS DISTINCT FROM d.content_bytes::text THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='AI002',MESSAGE='Retained S02 stored body, hash, byte count or receipt provenance changed'; END IF;
 IF p.page_number=1 AND p.request_url<>'https://api.massive.com/stocks/v1/short-interest?settlement_date.gte=2026-07-15&settlement_date.lte=2026-09-30&sort=settlement_date.asc,ticker.asc&limit=1000'
  OR p.page_number>1 AND (p.request_url!~'^https://api[.]massive[.]com/stocks/v1/short-interest[?]cursor=[A-Za-z0-9_.~%+\-]+$'
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.massive_shortinterest_page_v1 prev WHERE prev.archive_key=p.archive_key AND prev.page_number=p.page_number-1 AND prev.next_url=p.request_url)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='AI002',MESSAGE='Retained S02 page request or preceding cursor edge differs'; END IF;
 PERFORM astra_ingestion_v1.rpc_json_unique(d.content_text::json);b:=d.content_text::jsonb;
 IF b->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'OK' OR jsonb_typeof(b->'results') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR jsonb_array_length(b->'results') IS DISTINCT FROM p.result_count OR b->>'next_url' IS DISTINCT FROM p.next_url
  OR (p.next_url IS NOT NULL AND p.next_url!~'^https://api[.]massive[.]com/stocks/v1/short-interest[?]cursor=[A-Za-z0-9_.~%+\-]+$') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='AI002',MESSAGE='Retained S02 envelope, count or continuation differs'; END IF;
 SELECT count(*) INTO v_bad FROM jsonb_array_elements(b->'results') WITH ORDINALITY e(value,ord)
  LEFT JOIN population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.massive_shortinterest_record_v1 q ON q.archive_key=p.archive_key AND q.page_number=p.page_number AND q.source_row=e.ord
  WHERE jsonb_typeof(e.value)<>'object' OR q.source_id IS DISTINCT FROM p.source_id OR q.raw_record IS DISTINCT FROM e.value
   OR q.raw_record_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(e.value::text,'UTF8')),'hex')
   OR q.unit_key IS DISTINCT FROM 'MassiveSI:record:'||q.raw_record_sha256
   OR q.source_record_key IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.value->'ticker')='string' AND length(e.value->>'ticker') BETWEEN 1 AND 64
     AND e.value->>'ticker'!~'[[:cntrl:][:space:]]' AND astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_date_v2(e.value->>'settlement_date') IS NOT NULL
    THEN 'MassiveSI:business:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_array(e.value->>'ticker',astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_date_v2(e.value->>'settlement_date'))::text,'UTF8')),'hex')
    ELSE 'MassiveSI:unidentified:'||q.raw_record_sha256 END;
 IF v_bad<>0 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.massive_shortinterest_record_v1 WHERE archive_key=p.archive_key AND page_number=p.page_number)<>p.result_count THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='AI002',MESSAGE='Retained S02 normalized row, business key, digest or full-page census differs'; END IF;
 WITH anchors AS(SELECT anchor_ticker,min(member_id) member_id FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_members_v2 WHERE run_id=t.run_id GROUP BY anchor_ticker HAVING count(*)=1)
 SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(m.member_id,q.source_row,q.raw_record_sha256) ORDER BY q.source_row,m.member_id),'[]'),
  COALESCE(jsonb_agg(DISTINCT m.member_id ORDER BY m.member_id),'[]') INTO v_candidates,v_members
 FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.massive_shortinterest_record_v1 q JOIN anchors m ON m.anchor_ticker=q.raw_record->>'ticker'
 WHERE q.archive_key=p.archive_key AND q.page_number=p.page_number AND astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_date_v2(q.raw_record->>'settlement_date') BETWEEN '2026-07-15'::date AND '2026-07-31'::date;
 IF v_members IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value),'[]') FROM jsonb_array_elements(t.scope->'member_ids')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='AI005',MESSAGE='S02 candidate fixed-member set differs from its immutable task scope'; END IF;
 v_digest:=encode(sha256(convert_to(v_candidates::text,'UTF8')),'hex');
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('state','RETAINED_S02_SOURCE_VERIFIED','passed',true,'archive_key',p.archive_key,'archive_page',p.page_number,
  'source_id',p.source_id,'source_sha256',p.source_sha256,'stored_content_bytes',d.content_bytes,'wire_sha256',p.wire_sha256,
  'wire_bytes_retained',false,'hash_representation',d.evidence->>'hash_representation','source_request_url',p.request_url,
  'source_next_url',p.next_url,'source_observed_at',p.retrieved_at,'native_page_records',p.result_count,
  'referenced_candidate_records',jsonb_array_length(v_candidates),'candidate_digest',v_digest,
  'historical_attribution','UNRESOLVED_FROZEN_ANCHOR_CANDIDATE','publication_timestamp_supplied',false,
  'historical_receipt_certified',false,'full_replacement_query_satisfied',false,'original_archive_unchanged',true);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_shared_apply_delta_v2(p_run text, p_old jsonb, p_new jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 WITH delta AS(SELECT -1 sign,x.* FROM jsonb_to_recordset(p_old->'counts') x(family text,record_type text,kind text,period text,records bigint,occurrences bigint,versions bigint,conflicts bigint,fallback_keys bigint,boundary_crossing bigint,boundary_support bigint,links bigint,cohort_links bigint)
  UNION ALL SELECT 1,x.* FROM jsonb_to_recordset(p_new->'counts') x(family text,record_type text,kind text,period text,records bigint,occurrences bigint,versions bigint,conflicts bigint,fallback_keys bigint,boundary_crossing bigint,boundary_support bigint,links bigint,cohort_links bigint))
 INSERT INTO astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_shared_counts_v2
 SELECT p_run,family,record_type,kind,period,sum(sign*records),sum(sign*occurrences),sum(sign*versions),sum(sign*conflicts),sum(sign*fallback_keys),sum(sign*boundary_crossing),sum(sign*boundary_support),sum(sign*links),sum(sign*cohort_links)
 FROM delta GROUP BY family,record_type,kind,period
 ON CONFLICT(run_id,family,record_type,kind,period) DO UPDATE SET records=backfill_shared_counts_v2.records+EXCLUDED.records,
  occurrences=backfill_shared_counts_v2.occurrences+EXCLUDED.occurrences,versions=backfill_shared_counts_v2.versions+EXCLUDED.versions,
  conflicts=backfill_shared_counts_v2.conflicts+EXCLUDED.conflicts,fallback_keys=backfill_shared_counts_v2.fallback_keys+EXCLUDED.fallback_keys,
  boundary_crossing=backfill_shared_counts_v2.boundary_crossing+EXCLUDED.boundary_crossing,boundary_support=backfill_shared_counts_v2.boundary_support+EXCLUDED.boundary_support,
  links=backfill_shared_counts_v2.links+EXCLUDED.links,cohort_links=backfill_shared_counts_v2.cohort_links+EXCLUDED.cohort_links;
 WITH delta AS(SELECT -1 sign,x.* FROM jsonb_to_recordset(p_old->'fields') x(family text,record_type text,kind text,period text,field text,datatype text,nonnull boolean,reason text,records bigint)
  UNION ALL SELECT 1,x.* FROM jsonb_to_recordset(p_new->'fields') x(family text,record_type text,kind text,period text,field text,datatype text,nonnull boolean,reason text,records bigint))
 INSERT INTO astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_shared_fields_v2
 SELECT p_run,family,record_type,kind,period,field,datatype,nonnull,reason,sum(sign*records) FROM delta GROUP BY family,record_type,kind,period,field,datatype,nonnull,reason
 ON CONFLICT(run_id,family,record_type,kind,period,field,datatype,nonnull,reason) DO UPDATE SET records=backfill_shared_fields_v2.records+EXCLUDED.records;
 WITH delta AS(SELECT -1 sign,x.* FROM jsonb_to_recordset(p_old->'dates') x(family text,record_type text,date_axis text,period text,records bigint)
  UNION ALL SELECT 1,x.* FROM jsonb_to_recordset(p_new->'dates') x(family text,record_type text,date_axis text,period text,records bigint))
 INSERT INTO astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_shared_dates_v2
 SELECT p_run,family,record_type,date_axis,period,sum(sign*records) FROM delta GROUP BY family,record_type,date_axis,period
 ON CONFLICT(run_id,family,record_type,date_axis,period) DO UPDATE SET records=backfill_shared_dates_v2.records+EXCLUDED.records;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_shared_counts_v2 WHERE run_id=p_run AND LEAST(records,occurrences,versions,conflicts,fallback_keys,boundary_crossing,boundary_support,links,cohort_links)<0)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_shared_fields_v2 WHERE run_id=p_run AND records<0)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_shared_dates_v2 WHERE run_id=p_run AND records<0) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Shared logical counters became negative';END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_shared_refresh_v2(p_run text, p_keys jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- backfill_shared_refresh_bounded_keys_v2: bind each immutable archive lookup
 -- to one supplied key before joining compact intermediates. OFFSET0 keeps the
 -- parameterized key restriction from being flattened into a run-wide join.
 WITH keys AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT value record_key FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(p_keys)),
 versions AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT v.* FROM keys k CROSS JOIN LATERAL(
  SELECT v.* FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_shared_versions_v2 v
  WHERE v.run_id=p_run AND v.record_key=k.record_key OFFSET 0) v),
 stats AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT record_key,count(*) versions,bool_and(version_timestamp IS NOT NULL) ordered,max(version_timestamp) latest FROM versions GROUP BY record_key),
 candidates AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT v.*,s.versions,s.ordered FROM versions v JOIN stats s USING(record_key) WHERE NOT s.ordered OR v.version_timestamp=s.latest),
 candidate_counts AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT record_key,count(*) n FROM candidates GROUP BY record_key),
 chosen AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT DISTINCT ON(record_key) * FROM candidates ORDER BY record_key,row_sha256,task_id,page_no,record_ordinal),
 votes AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT c.record_key,f.key field,count(*) n,count(DISTINCT f.value->>'value_sha256') values,
  bool_or((f.value->>'nonnull')::boolean) nonnull,min(f.value->>'datatype') datatype
  FROM candidates c CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(c.field_states) f GROUP BY c.record_key,f.key),
 fields AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT c.record_key,jsonb_object_agg(v.field,COALESCE(c.field_states->v.field,jsonb_build_object('datatype',v.datatype,'nonnull',v.nonnull))||
  CASE WHEN v.n<n.n OR v.values>1 THEN jsonb_build_object('nonnull',v.nonnull,'reason','CONFLICTING_PROVIDER_RECORD_VERSIONS') ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) states,
  COALESCE(jsonb_agg(v.field ORDER BY v.field) FILTER(WHERE v.n<n.n OR v.values>1),'[]') conflicts
  FROM chosen c JOIN votes v USING(record_key) JOIN candidate_counts n USING(record_key) GROUP BY c.record_key),
 clean AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT c.*,n.n candidates,f.states,f.conflicts,
  (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(d.key,CASE WHEN f.conflicts ? CASE d.key WHEN 'publication_date_new_york' THEN c.primary_date_field WHEN 'market_session_new_york' THEN 't' ELSE d.key END THEN 'null'::jsonb ELSE d.value END),'{}') FROM jsonb_each(c.date_axes) d) clean_axes
  FROM chosen c JOIN fields f USING(record_key) JOIN candidate_counts n USING(record_key)),
 dated AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT c.*,a.first_date,a.last_date,COALESCE(a.in_target,false) in_target
  FROM clean c LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT min((value#>>'{}')::date) first_date,max((value#>>'{}')::date) last_date,
   bool_or((value#>>'{}')::date BETWEEN '2025-09-01'::date AND '2026-07-31'::date) in_target FROM jsonb_each(c.clean_axes) WHERE value<>'null'::jsonb) a ON true),
 occurrences AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT k.record_key,count(*) n FROM keys k CROSS JOIN LATERAL(
  SELECT 1 FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_shared_occurrences_v2 o
  WHERE o.run_id=p_run AND o.record_key=k.record_key OFFSET 0) o GROUP BY k.record_key)
 INSERT INTO astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_shared_records_v2
 SELECT p_run,c.record_key,c.row_sha256,c.provider,c.record_type,c.kind,c.record_group,c.provider_record_id,c.identity_basis,
  CASE WHEN c.record_type='ACTION' AND c.conflicts ?| ARRAY['ticker','symbol','initiating_symbol'] THEN NULL ELSE c.symbol END,
  CASE WHEN c.conflicts ? c.primary_date_field THEN NULL ELSE c.market_date END,c.clean_axes,c.primary_date_field,
  CASE WHEN c.in_target THEN 'TARGET' WHEN c.last_date<'2025-09-01'::date THEN 'SUPPORT' WHEN c.first_date>'2026-07-31'::date THEN 'AFTER_TARGET'
   WHEN c.first_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'BOUNDARY_SUPPORT' ELSE 'UNKNOWN_DATE' END,
  COALESCE(c.first_date<'2025-09-01'::date AND c.last_date>='2025-09-01'::date OR c.first_date<='2026-07-31'::date AND c.last_date>'2026-07-31'::date,false),
  COALESCE(NOT c.in_target AND c.first_date<'2025-09-01'::date AND c.last_date>'2026-07-31'::date,false),
  c.versions,c.candidates,c.ordered,o.n,c.conflicts,c.states,c.delivery_families,c.task_id,c.page_no,c.record_ordinal
 FROM dated c JOIN occurrences o USING(record_key)
 ON CONFLICT(run_id,record_key) DO UPDATE SET row_sha256=EXCLUDED.row_sha256,kind=EXCLUDED.kind,record_group=EXCLUDED.record_group,
  provider_record_id=EXCLUDED.provider_record_id,identity_basis=EXCLUDED.identity_basis,symbol=EXCLUDED.symbol,market_date=EXCLUDED.market_date,
  date_axes=EXCLUDED.date_axes,primary_date_field=EXCLUDED.primary_date_field,period=EXCLUDED.period,boundary_crossing=EXCLUDED.boundary_crossing,boundary_support=EXCLUDED.boundary_support,
  source_versions=EXCLUDED.source_versions,current_candidate_versions=EXCLUDED.current_candidate_versions,ordered_versions=EXCLUDED.ordered_versions,
  source_occurrences=EXCLUDED.source_occurrences,conflict_fields=EXCLUDED.conflict_fields,field_states=EXCLUDED.field_states,delivery_families=EXCLUDED.delivery_families,
  task_id=EXCLUDED.task_id,page_no=EXCLUDED.page_no,record_ordinal=EXCLUDED.record_ordinal;

 DELETE FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_shared_links_v2 l USING jsonb_array_elements_text(p_keys) k WHERE l.run_id=p_run AND l.record_key=k.value;
 WITH keys AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT DISTINCT value record_key FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(p_keys)),
 scoped_versions AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT v.* FROM keys k CROSS JOIN LATERAL(
  SELECT v.record_key,v.row_sha256,v.version_timestamp FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_shared_versions_v2 v
  WHERE v.run_id=p_run AND v.record_key=k.record_key OFFSET 0) v),
 scoped_records AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT r.* FROM keys k CROSS JOIN LATERAL(
  SELECT r.record_key,r.ordered_versions,r.current_candidate_versions FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_shared_records_v2 r
  WHERE r.run_id=p_run AND r.record_key=k.record_key OFFSET 0) r),
 scoped_links AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT l.* FROM keys k CROSS JOIN LATERAL(
  SELECT l.record_key,l.row_sha256,l.security_symbol,l.link_role FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_shared_version_links_v2 l
  WHERE l.run_id=p_run AND l.record_key=k.record_key OFFSET 0) l),
 vstat AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT record_key,max(version_timestamp) latest FROM scoped_versions GROUP BY record_key),
 links AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT l.record_key,l.security_symbol,l.link_role,count(*) observed_versions,
  count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT r.ordered_versions OR v.version_timestamp=s.latest) current_versions
  FROM scoped_links l JOIN scoped_records r USING(record_key)
  JOIN scoped_versions v ON v.record_key=l.record_key AND v.row_sha256=l.row_sha256
  JOIN vstat s ON s.record_key=l.record_key
  GROUP BY l.record_key,l.security_symbol,l.link_role)
 INSERT INTO astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_shared_links_v2
 SELECT p_run,l.record_key,l.security_symbol,l.link_role,l.observed_versions,l.current_versions,
  CASE WHEN l.current_versions=r.current_candidate_versions THEN 'PRESENT_IN_ALL_CURRENT_PROVIDER_VERSIONS'
   WHEN l.current_versions=0 THEN 'RETAINED_OLDER_PROVIDER_VERSION_LINK' ELSE 'CONFLICTING_PROVIDER_RECORD_LINK_VERSIONS' END,
  COALESCE(m.members,'[]'),CASE WHEN m.n=1 THEN 'UNRESOLVED_FROZEN_ANCHOR_CANDIDATE' WHEN m.n>1 THEN 'AMBIGUOUS_FROZEN_ANCHOR_CANDIDATES' ELSE 'OUTSIDE_FROZEN_ANCHOR_SET' END
 FROM links l JOIN scoped_records r ON r.record_key=l.record_key
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT count(*) n,jsonb_agg(member_id ORDER BY member_id) members FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_members_v2 m WHERE m.run_id=p_run AND m.anchor_ticker=l.security_symbol) m ON true;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_shared_summary_v2(p_run text, p_keys jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 WITH touched AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT r.*,f.family,COALESCE(l.links,0) links,COALESCE(l.cohort_links,0) cohort_links
  FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_shared_records_v2 r JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text(p_keys) k ON r.record_key=k.value
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(r.delivery_families) f(family)
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT count(*) links,count(*) FILTER(WHERE jsonb_array_length(candidate_member_ids)>0) cohort_links
   FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_shared_links_v2 l WHERE l.run_id=r.run_id AND l.record_key=r.record_key AND l.link_role='ARTICLE_SECURITY') l ON true
  WHERE r.run_id=p_run),
 counts AS(SELECT family,record_type,kind,period,count(*) records,sum(source_occurrences) occurrences,sum(source_versions) versions,
  count(*) FILTER(WHERE jsonb_array_length(conflict_fields)>0) conflicts,count(*) FILTER(WHERE identity_basis LIKE 'EXACT_CONTENT_FALLBACK%') fallback_keys,
  count(*) FILTER(WHERE boundary_crossing) boundary_crossing,count(*) FILTER(WHERE boundary_support) boundary_support,sum(links) links,sum(cohort_links) cohort_links
  FROM touched GROUP BY family,record_type,kind,period),
 fields AS(SELECT family,record_type,kind,period,f.key field,f.value->>'datatype' datatype,(f.value->>'nonnull')::boolean nonnull,
  COALESCE(f.value->>'reason','') reason,count(*) records FROM touched CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(field_states) f
  GROUP BY family,record_type,kind,period,f.key,f.value->>'datatype',(f.value->>'nonnull')::boolean,COALESCE(f.value->>'reason','')),
 dates AS(SELECT family,record_type,f.key date_axis,CASE WHEN f.value='null'::jsonb THEN 'UNKNOWN_DATE'
  WHEN (f.value#>>'{}')::date<'2025-09-01'::date THEN 'SUPPORT' WHEN (f.value#>>'{}')::date>'2026-07-31'::date THEN 'AFTER_TARGET' ELSE 'TARGET' END period,count(*) records
  FROM touched CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(date_axes) f GROUP BY family,record_type,f.key,4)
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('counts',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c)),'[]') FROM counts c),
  'fields',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(f)),'[]') FROM fields f),'dates',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d)),'[]') FROM dates d))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION astra_ingestion_v1.rpc_ascii_string(p_value text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_text text:=pg_catalog.to_jsonb(p_value)::text; v_result text;
BEGIN
 -- rpc_ascii_linear_v2: PostgreSQL performs JSON escaping once. Preserve its

 IF (v_text COLLATE "C") !~ '[^ -~]' THEN RETURN v_text; END IF;
 SELECT pg_catalog.string_agg(
  CASE WHEN cp>=65536 THEN

   WHEN cp>=127 THEN E'\\u'||pg_catalog.lpad(pg_catalog.to_hex(cp),4,'0')
   ELSE piece END,'' ORDER BY ordinal)
 INTO v_result
 FROM (SELECT m[1] piece,pg_catalog.ascii(m[1]) cp,ordinal
   FROM pg_catalog.regexp_matches(v_text COLLATE "C",'([ -~]+|[^ -~])','g') WITH ORDINALITY r(m,ordinal)) x;
